# Support

## Important Notice

This repository is published for transparency, reproducibility, and scientific audit purposes only. 

There is no active maintenance or community support. The development team does not commit to responding to questions, issues, or requests from third parties.

## What This Means

| Action | Response |
|--------|----------|
| Opening GitHub issues | May not receive a response |
| Sending emails with questions | May not receive a response |
| Requesting features or changes | Will not be implemented |
| Submitting pull requests | Will not be reviewed or merged |

## Exceptions

We may respond to:

- Critical errors affecting scientific validity of published results
- Data privacy concerns (e.g., inadvertent PII exposure)
- Communications from New Seed or project funders

For these cases only: [info@azahardata.com](mailto:info@azahardata.com)

## Self-Service Resources

If you wish to use or adapt this code:

1. Fork the repository
2. Review [README.md](../README.md) for project overview
3. Review the [Technical Documentation](https://newseed.azahardata.com/web-guatemala) for methodology details
4. Consult standard R documentation for technical questions
